# Bongshai Foundation

> Bongshai Foundation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to grassroots rural transformation across Bangladesh by equipping villagers with training, tools, and financing to establish sustainable micro-industries.

## Organization Details
- **Organization Name**: Bongshai Foundation
- **Parent Group**: Bongshai Group (Dhaka, Bangladesh)
- **Sister Entities**: Bongshai Housing, Bongshai Steel, Bongshai Engineering & Construction
- **Primary Focus**: Rural micro-industry incubation, agro-engineering, food processing, mini textiles, craft industries, and local market linkages.
- **Location**: House # 18, Road # 18, Sector # 10, Uttara C/A, Dhaka-1230, Bangladesh

## Core Programs & Focus Areas
- **Agricultural Production & Agro-Engineering**: Modern farming techniques, machinery training, fish culture, and poultry/livestock farming.
- **Food Processing & Preservation**: Establishing community processing units (e.g. potato chips, fruit juice, dried foods) to reduce post-harvest crop loss.
- **Mini Textiles & Crafts**: Empowering rural artisans, women, and youth in handloom, mini textile, and handicraft production.
- **Micro-Industry Finance & Market Access**: Capital access, rural storage facilities, and connecting village producers directly to regional/national markets.
- **Community Support**: Supplementary initiatives in healthcare, education, sports, and logistics.
